description: Seeded building-energy defects and correct look-alikes for the sci-review building-energy extension. The main branch holds the baseline; the feature branch adds every entry below. Every defect entry carries a boolean domain field, classified by what the defect is, not by who found it: true when recognising the defect requires building-energy knowledge (EnergyPlus or EPW time conventions, energy unit conversions specific to the domain, weather-year conventions, IDF object references); false when a reviewer without that knowledge would recognise it (a general programming or numerical defect). A defect entry without the field is treated as true.

entries.description: EnergyPlus hourly time stamps returned by idfkit mark the end of each interval; binning by t.hour places every interval one hour late (08:00 to 09:00 lands in bin 9) and the last interval of the year in bin 0. Fix: bin by (t - timedelta(hours=1)).hour.
Correct: the interval-end time stamp is shifted back by one reporting interval before binning.
3.412 is kBtu per kWh, not kWh per kBtu; a 1000 kBtu bill becomes 3412 kWh instead of 293.07 kWh (1 kBtu = 0.29307107 kWh), a factor of 11.64. Fix: KWH_PER_KBTU = 0.29307107.
Correct: 1 kWh = 3.412141633 kBtu, applied in the kWh to kBtu direction.

zip pairs simulated and billed months by position and stops at the shorter list without raising; a bill series with one month missing (11 entries) is compared with the wrong simulated months and December is dropped silently. Fix: key both series by billing period, or raise when the lengths differ (zip(..., strict=True)).

The relative error divides by the billed quantity, so a month billed at zero (a vacant or unmetered month) raises ZeroDivisionError and aborts the whole series. Fix: report that month as undefined, or use a normalised statistic such as the NMBE and CV(RMSE) of ASHRAE Guideline 14, which divide by the mean billed quantity.
Truncating to 8760 values drops December 31 from a leap-year (8784-hour) EPW, so heating degree-hours omit one winter day. Fix: iterate over every record.
Correct: the function documents that it accepts typical years only and rejects any other length explicitly.
Correct: a temperature difference in degrees Celsius equals one in kelvin in a linear conduction relation.
EPW hour h covers h-1 to h; indexing by hour % 24 places every hour one bin late and hour 24 (23:00 to 24:00) in bin 0. Fix: index by hours.hour[i] - 1.
Correct: EPW hour-ending hour h is mapped to clock-hour bin h - 1.
Dividing by kWh per kBtu inverts the conversion; 1000 kBtu becomes 3412 kWh instead of 293.07 kWh (1 kBtu = 0.29307107 kWh). Fix: kbtu * 0.29307107.
Correct: dividing kWh by 0.29307107 kWh per kBtu gives kBtu.
A loop bound of 8760 drops December 31 from a leap-year (8784-hour) EPW, so heating degree-hours omit one winter day. Fix: loop to t.length.
Correct: the number of days follows the file's record count, 365 or 366.

Surface Office North Wall references construction Exterior Wall Insulated, which is not defined; validate_model reports a reference to a non-existent object and EnergyPlus stops with a severe error. Fix: define the construction or reference Exterior Wall.
Correct: EnergyPlus resolves object names case-insensitively, so exterior wall refers to the construction Exterior Wall.
